items.mainDefect: The migration inserts the old embeddable_hosts values without normalizing them (scheme, path and whitespace are kept), so the migrated rows never match uri.host in record_for_host.

secondary.defect: Host values are put into the raw SQL INSERT by string interpolation without quoting, so a value containing a quote breaks the INSERT and aborts the migration.

items.mainDefect: record_for_host lowercases only the stored column and not uri.host, so hosts containing uppercase letters are rejected.

secondary.defect: The lookup compares only the bare host, so hosts saved with a :port suffix (which the validator allows) never match.

items.mainDefect: The store's new _ids branch always deletes the original *_ids key and replaces it with looked-up objects, so ids that can't be resolved become undefined entries and the raw id data is lost.

secondary.defect: A null *_ids value throws a TypeError when .map is called on it.
The `hydrated || []` fallback is dead code because map always returns an array.

items.mainDefect: The _ids branch calls obj[k].map without checking that the value is an array, so a null *_ids value throws and breaks hydration; the || [] guard is applied to map's result and never takes effect.

secondary.defect: Ids that _lookupSubType can't resolve stay in the hydrated array as undefined.

items.mainDefect: Every key ending in _ids is now deleted unconditionally and replaced with an array of looked-up objects, which are undefined when the type isn't sideloaded, so models lose their raw *_ids arrays.

secondary.defect: The new pluralized property can overwrite an existing real field with the same name.

items.mainDefect: The migration inserts the old setting's values (which may be full URLs with a scheme or path) as-is, skipping normalization, so the migrated hosts never match in record_for_host and embedding breaks.

secondary.defect: Values are interpolated into raw SQL without escaping or quoting.

items.mainDefect: The migration crashes with NoMethodError when the embed_category (or uncategorized_category_id) row is missing, because it indexes an empty execute result.

secondary.defect: Hosts are inserted without normalization, so values that still have an http(s):// prefix or a path never match uri.host and embedding breaks after the upgrade.
Host values are not quoted in the raw SQL INSERT, so a single quote in a value breaks the migration.

items.mainDefect: The plural _ids branch calls obj[k].map without a null check, so a null *_ids value throws.

secondary.defect: The original id array is always deleted even when no matching sideloaded collection exists, so plain id arrays are replaced with arrays of undefined.
